verdict.rationale: The Plus plan lists "classes" as a feature, and Kick generates standard reports (P&L, Balance Sheet organized by the Chart of Accounts), including via MCP/CLI and live Google Sheets data. Nothing shows a custom report builder that filters or groups by class, so the dimensional-reporting part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented custom report builder, filtering/grouping reports by class, location or tag dimensions, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
